# Vocabula

> Vocabula is a vocabulary flashcard app for iPhone and iPad, covering Kindergarten through Grade 12. The deck holds 4,241 cards in three subjects — 1,963 English words, 814 Math terms and 1,464 Science terms — with thirteen grades in each subject. Every card is built into the app, so it works offline with no network connection. There is no account and no sign-in, no ads, no analytics and no tracking of any kind: nothing is collected, and the few things the app remembers stay on the device. The download is free, and ten definitions are open inside the app; a single $4.99 in-app purchase in the United States, which does not renew, unlocks the rest. Requires iOS 17.0 or later. On the App Store since Wednesday, October 14, 2026.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vocabula-k-12-vocabulary/id6819035983 (App Store ID id6819035983)

## Key facts

- Vocabulary flashcards for English, Math and Science, Kindergarten through Grade 12, on iPhone and iPad.
- 4,241 cards: 1,963 English words, 814 Math terms, 1,464 Science terms; thirteen grades in each subject.
- Works offline: every card is built into the app.
- Free download with ten definitions open; one $4.99 in-app purchase (Full Access unlock, United States price) unlocks every card. Paid once, does not renew.
- No ads, no subscription, no account, no analytics, no tracking. App Store privacy label: Data Not Collected.
